contexts.text: The man of the Spiritual Church... discusses about truths; differently from the man of the Celestial Church, who... does not discuss about truths. The truths by which the man of the Spiritual Church defends himself, and concerning which he discusses, are from the doctrine which he acknowledges.
The spiritual man... discusses whether it is so, unless he has been confirmed by much experience; which the celestial never do.

They who are in the affection of truth think, investigate, and discuss whether this is true; and when they are confirmed that it is true, they think, investigate, and discuss, what it is; thus they stick at the first threshold...
There was discussed with them concerning...
